rating.verdict: It looks like a joke (no real lands at all), but Belcher is a real Modern deck that keeps going 5-0 in Magic Online leagues through 2026. When it works it wins on turn 2 or 3; when the opponent has the right hate card it just loses.
strengths: Can win on turn 2 with Goblin Charbelcher
Stormscale Scion gives a second, completely different way to win
weaknesses: Artifact hate (Force of Vigor, Haywire Mite, Meltdown) stops Belcher
Counterspells and discard on the key turn
Very swingy: some hands do nothing

wins: Goblin Charbelcher reveals cards until it hits a land, and this deck has no land cards in the library. Every card in your deck counts as damage, so one activation deals 20 or more.
plan: Play a spell-land (Valakut Awakening, Spikefield Hazard…) as a land, or Ruby Medallion with a ritual. Strike It Rich makes a Treasure.
Chain rituals into Irencrag Feat (seven red mana), then cast Goblin Charbelcher (4) and activate it (3) in the same turn.
Rituals into Stormscale Scion with a big storm count: a flight of 5/5 Dragons, given haste by sacrificing Bitter Reunion.
Point Charbelcher at the opponent: damage equals the cards left in your library.
keys: {3}, tap: reveal until a land; damage equals the nonland cards revealed. With no lands in the library, that's your whole deck.
Seven red mana: exactly Belcher (4) plus its activation (3). Only one more spell is allowed that turn, and the activation isn't a spell.
Red spells cost {1} less, so the rituals make more mana than they cost.
Storm makes a copy for each spell cast before it this turn; copies are 5/5 flying Dragons thanks to each other.
Bottom bad cards to draw new ones, or play it as a land.
tips: The double-faced spells only count as lands on the battlefield. In your library they are instants and sorceries, so Charbelcher reveals straight past them.
If you have played several spell-lands, Charbelcher still deals damage equal to the cards remaining in your library: count before you go for it.
Ruby Medallion doesn't reduce Goblin Charbelcher or its activation: they're colorless.
Cast Irencrag Feat last: after it you get only one more spell, so it should be Charbelcher (or Stormscale Scion).
Manamorphose and Strike It Rich are free storm count for Stormscale Scion.
Bitter Reunion: discard Goblin Charbelcher's extras or a spent spell-land to draw two; later sacrifice it for haste.
mulligan: Keep hands with a mana source (spell-land, Ruby Medallion or Strike It Rich), rituals, and either Charbelcher or a way to dig for it. Mulligan hands that can't do anything by turn 3.
sideboard: Extra Blood Moon and a Mountain
